name: Aeroflex Industries Limited
tagline: Niche metallic flexible flow solutions (stainless steel hoses) manufacturer with exceptional recent growth (+36% TTM revenue, +42% profit) but concerning ROCE deterioration (36% FY22 → 19% FY26) and aggressive capex signal valuation stretched at 107x P/E
business_overview: Aeroflex manufactures stainless steel flexible hoses, assemblies, fittings, and corrugated tubing used for controlled flow applications. Part of Sat Industries. 2,938 SKUs across industrial, automotive, HVAC, medical, and appliance end-markets. Near-monopoly position in domestic stainless steel hose market with import tariff protection. Recent expansion into liquid cooling systems (SFN segment) for data centers.
fundamentals_table: FY26 Rs 442 Cr (+16% YoY); TTM Rs 503 Cr (+36% YoY); Q1 FY27 Rs 145 Cr (+72% YoY)
FY26 Rs 56 Cr (+20% YoY); TTM Rs 67 Cr (+42% YoY); Q1 FY27 Rs 19 Cr (+162% YoY)
Debt-free (Rs 9 Cr borrowings FY26 from Rs 1 Cr FY25)
FY26 Rs 120 Cr (~27% of revenue) for new hose lines + SFN assembly
P/E ~107x TTM; P/B ~16.2x; stock up 190% in 1 year from Rs 158 lows
fundamentals_narrative: Aeroflex has delivered exceptional 5-year revenue CAGR of 25% (to Rs 442 Cr FY26) and profit CAGR of 50% (to Rs 56 Cr). Q1 FY27 shows even faster momentum (+72% revenue, +162% profit YoY). However, ROCE has collapsed from 36% (FY22) to 19% (FY26), a critical red flag: capex is not generating incremental returns. FY26 capex at Rs 120 Cr (27% of revenue) is nearly double FY24 levels. Cash conversion is weak: CFO Rs 66 Cr but FCF negative at -Rs 5 Cr due to high capex and working capital build (CCC 112 days, inventory days 122). Q1 FY27's +72% revenue is likely a seasonal peak (Q1 typically strongest for industrial equipment), suggesting pent-up H1 orders hit in Q1.
technical_read: Stock at Rs 544 (Oct 5, 2026), up 190% from 52W low of Rs 158 but down 7% from 52W high of Rs 584. Recent momentum driven by Q1 FY27 beat. P/E of 107x is historically extreme vs 20-25x peer average, pricing 25-30% EPS CAGR that capex intensity and ROCE trajectory do not support.
sentiment_summary: Limited public discourse; IPO (Aug 2023 at Rs 175-200) suggests retail enthusiasm. Q1 FY27 beat has driven strong momentum but valuation has outpaced fundamentals.
community_signal: No ValuePickr thread found (web discovery only).
bse_notes: No SEBI action or auditor qualification found. Credit ratings: Infomerics A+ (stable) as of Oct 2023.
bull_case: Niche monopoly: near-monopoly in domestic stainless steel hose with import tariff protection
Secular tailwinds: industrial expansion, data center cooling (SFN), Make in India policies
Margin expansion: OPM improved from 20% (FY24) to 23% (FY26); further expansion possible
Capex cycle: Q1 FY27 +72% revenue suggests new hose lines and SFN ramp is real and accelerating
Capital light at scale: Once capex cycle completes, FCF should normalize and returns improve
bear_case: ROCE collapse: From 36% (FY22) to 19% (FY26) despite capex; capital not generating returns yet
Capex intensity: Rs 120 Cr (27% of revenue) unsustainable if revenue doesn't accelerate 25%+ CAGR; FCF negative through FY27-28
Working capital: CCC expanded to 112 days; inventory at 122 days suggests buildup ahead of uncertain demand
Valuation stretched: 107x P/E prices 25-30% EPS CAGR; if capex ROE stabilizes at 16-18%, stock should trade 40-50x not current multiples
Q1 seasonality: Q1 FY27 likely a peak-quarter effect; H1 FY27 results will clarify true run-rate
Competitive risk: OEMs could enter SS hose segment if tariff protection removed
verdict_headline: Niche player in midcycle capex expansion, but valuation has severely outpaced fundamentals: ROCE deterioration and negative FCF signal execution risk
verdict_reasoning: Business has genuine niche moat (near-monopoly in domestic SS hose) and secular tailwinds; justifies Medium-High conviction on the story
But deep dive reveals critical execution risk: ROCE fell from 36% to 19%, working capital deteriorated, FCF turned negative; capex has not yet delivered normalized returns
Q1 FY27 (+72% revenue, +162% profit) likely a seasonal peak; true run-rate unclear until H1 results
Valuation at 107x P/E is 2-2.5x too high for realistic EPS trajectory; should trade 60-70x forward earnings not current multiples

Conviction on business = Medium-High; conviction on stock = SELL at current levels. Revisit if (i) Q2-Q3 FY27 confirm 30%+ revenue run-rate, (ii) ROCE improves toward 25%, (iii) FCF turns positive, (iv) valuation compresses to 60-70x

5-year profit CAGR: FY20 Rs 5 Cr → FY26 Rs 56 Cr (50% CAGR); TTM Rs 67 Cr
ROCE trend (red flag): FY21 17% → FY22 36% (peak) → FY23 34% → FY24 26% → FY25 22% → FY26 19%; clear deterioration
OPM trend: FY20 15% → FY26 23%; marginally expanding but not enough to offset ROCE decline
Capex ramp: FY24 Rs 64 Cr → FY25 Rs 74 Cr → FY26 Rs 120 Cr (doubling for new hose lines + SFN)
FCF: FY24 Rs 6 Cr → FY25 -Rs 78 Cr → FY26 -Rs 5 Cr; negative due to capex and working capital build
CCC: FY20 64 days → FY22 132 days (COVID) → FY26 112 days; still elevated, working capital absorbing growth

Q1 typically strongest quarter for industrial equipment; pent-up H1 orders likely hit in Q1

open_questions: Is Q1 FY27 sustainable or a peak-quarter effect? H1 results will clarify.
When does capex normalize? If not until FY28, FCF will remain negative.
What is SFN segment's revenue contribution and margin profile?
Will ROCE stabilize at 22-25% once capex cycle completes, or is 19% the new baseline?
What is the addressable market for domestic SS hoses, and how much share can Aeroflex gain?
deep_dive.conviction_update: Medium-High on the business (moat + tailwinds intact) but cautious on stock valuation (107x P/E is unsustainable). Will revisit once H1 FY27 results available (expected Nov 2026) to validate if Q1 was one-off or start of sustained ramp.
